svg.aria-label: Block (0, 0) in 2 phases, 1 colour per thread. Phase 0: the tile of A at columns 0 and 1 (1 2, 5 6) and the tile of B at rows 0 and 1 (1 0, 0 1) are outlined in the global matrices; each value is coloured by the thread that copies it into the same slot of tileA or tileB in shared memory; the 4 sums are then 1, 2, 5 and 6. Phase 1: the tile of A moves to columns 2 and 3 (3 4, 7 8) and the tile of B to rows 2 and 3 (2 1, 1 2); the sums become 11, 13, 27 and 29, the top-left square of C.
svg.text: Each colour marks 1 thread: the values it copies, the slots it fills, its sum.
tiles at columns 0 to 1 of A and rows 0 to 1 of B
the tile of A moves right, the tile of B moves down
